segments.text: The October release launched to the five percent pilot today, October 16. The pilot launch is completed.
In this synthetic pilot, payment success is 99.2 percent across 250 test payments. There are no duplicate charges.
Crash-free sessions are 99.8 percent in the demo cohort. The rollback runbook is published and the rollback drill passed.
The launch monitoring checklist is completed. I will add a payment reconciliation alert by Monday, October 19.
One participant missed the offline sync indicator. I will deliver a clearer indicator design by Wednesday, October 21.
I will implement the approved offline sync indicator by Friday, October 23. This does not block the payment pilot.
Decision: keep the pilot at five percent until Meridian compliance signs off. Metrics alone do not authorize expansion.
Keep Tuesday, October 20 as the provisional expansion date until we hear back from compliance.
